en.name: Eucharistic Vision of Blessed Angela of Foligno
en.summary: A medieval mystic dictated visions of Christ appearing to her within the consecrated Host.
en.body: Between 1292 and 1296, Blessed Angela of Foligno dictated to her Franciscan confessor a series of visions in which Christ appeared to her within the Host, described at different times as two shining eyes and as a boy seated in majesty.
